description: This PHP source file implements a CalDAV provider class for SuiteCRM, handling connection testing, event retrieval, creation, updating, and deletion via CalDAV protocol with HTTP Basic Authentication.

classes.name: CalDAVProvider
classes.description: A class implementing CalDAV protocol interactions for SuiteCRM, including connection testing, event management, and synchronization with external CalDAV servers.

methods.name: testCalendarConnection
methods.description: Tests the connection to the CalDAV server, returning success status and connection details.

methods.name: getAuthHeaders
methods.description: Generates HTTP Basic Authentication headers using connection credentials.

methods.name: getCalendarUrl
methods.description: Retrieves the calendar URL from the connection configuration.

methods.name: makeCalDAVRequest
methods.description: Performs an HTTP request to the CalDAV server with specified method, URL, headers, and body.

methods.name: buildPropfindXml
methods.description: Constructs XML body for PROPFIND request to discover calendar properties.

methods.name: getEvents
methods.description: Retrieves calendar events from the CalDAV server based on a query.

methods.name: formatDateTimeAsUTC
methods.description: Converts a DateTime object to UTC and formats it for iCalendar.

methods.name: buildCalendarQueryXml
methods.description: Builds XML for calendar-query REPORT requests with optional time range filters.

methods.name: parseCalendarQueryResponse
methods.description: Parses XML response from calendar-query to extract events.

methods.name: parseICalendarData
methods.description: Parses iCalendar data into a CalendarAccountEvent object.

methods.name: parseICalDateTime
methods.description: Parses iCalendar date-time strings into DateTime objects, considering time zones.

methods.name: calculateEndDateFromDuration
methods.description: Calculates event end date from start date and duration string.

methods.name: unescapeICalValue
methods.description: Unescapes special characters in iCalendar field values.

methods.name: getEvent
methods.description: Retrieves a specific event by ID from the CalDAV server.

methods.name: convertToICalendar
methods.description: Converts a CalendarAccountEvent object into iCalendar format string.

methods.name: escapeICalValue
methods.description: Escapes special characters for iCalendar field values.

methods.name: doCreateEvent
methods.description: Creates a new event on the CalDAV server.

methods.name: doUpdateEvent
methods.description: Updates an existing event on the CalDAV server.

methods.name: doDeleteEvent
methods.description: Deletes an event from the CalDAV server.
